forensics.forensics_verdict: Zaggle's revenue and PAT trajectory is genuinely strong, but cash generation has not kept pace — FCF negative 2 of last 3 years despite scale. Intangibles capitalization practice inflates reported margins. No leverage risk but governance complexity warrants monitoring. Financial profile improving on P&L but deteriorating on cash quality.

competitive.industry_overview: India B2B corporate spend management and prepaid fintech. Market size ~₹2-3 lakh Cr in total addressable corporate spend; digital platform penetration <5%. No direct listed Indian peer — Zaggle is unique on NSE/BSE.
competitive.company_positioning: First-mover and only listed B2B spend-management SaaS in India. 50M+ prepaid cards issued. Banking partnerships with Axis, ICICI, SBI. Enterprise white-label lock-in. Positioned as a 'full-stack' corporate financial wellness platform.

sector.name: B2B Fintech — Corporate Spend Management & Prepaid
sector.overview: India's B2B corporate spend management market is in early-to-mid growth phase with <5% digital penetration of an estimated ₹2-3 lakh Cr total addressable corporate spend. Organized digital platforms are benefiting from corporate digitization, GST input-credit complexity, and RBI FLDG regulatory clarity. Dual revenue model (SaaS subscription + interchange/float) is unique positioning. Sector P/E for listed fintech-SaaS: 40-80x.

growth_drivers.driver: GST input credit complexity driving automated tools
RBI FLDG clarity — fintechs extending credit with prepaid
SME payroll digitization — PM VIKAS / DPIIT programs
